images.filename: Jumbo Rocks Campground in Joshua Tree National Park - 10.jpg
images.caption: Jumbo Rocks Campground is centrally located and offers great opportunities for scrambling around the boulders Joshua Tree National Park is known for. Skull Rock Nature Trail loops near the campground, leading visitors among the rock features and native plants of the area. There are 124 individual/family sites in this campground. All are first come, first served.
images.alt: Jumbo Rocks Campground is centrally located and offers great opportunities for scrambling around the boulders Joshua Tree National Park is known for. Skull Rock Nature Trail loops near the campground, leading visitors among the rock features and native plants of the area. There are 124 individual/family sites in this campground. All are first come, first served.

images.filename: Joshua tree keys view pano more vertical.jpg
images.caption:
Panorama of the view south from Keys View in the Little San Bernadino Mountains, Joshua Tree National Park, California.
Visible landmarks are the Salton Sea (230ft below sea level) at rear left, along towards the center the Santa Rosa Mountains behind Indio and the San Jacinto Mountains behind Palm Springs.
In the valley floor, the San Andreas Fault is visible. At the rear right is the 11,500 ft Mount San Gorgonio.
images.alt:
Panorama of the view south from Keys View in the Little San Bernadino Mountains, Joshua Tree National Park, California.
Visible landmarks are the Salton Sea (230ft below sea level) at rear left, along towards the center the Santa Rosa Mountains behind Indio and the San Jacinto Mountains behind Palm Springs.
In the valley floor, the San Andreas Fault is visible. At the rear right is the 11,500 ft Mount San Gorgonio.
